inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission. The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026.

On Tuesday, 24 March 2026, during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition, new details were deliberately pushed into Parliament to drag South African actress Terry Pheto into alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission. This isn't just about money or random corruption; it is a calculated script managed by the hidden elites to control the narrative and distract the public from the real levers of power. Every official investigation is carefully orchestrated theatre designed to manufacture compliance and hide the true coordination at the top.
